component.name: Do Not Forget
component.summary: Meeting reminders in the system tray

description.p: Do Not Forget keeps your next meeting one glance away. It shows today's agenda from your Google calendars in the system tray, reminds you before a meeting starts and lets you join Meet, Zoom or Teams calls or answer invitations in one click.

ul.li: Reminders before a meeting and a full-screen alert when it starts
One-click join links for Google Meet, Zoom and Microsoft Teams
Accept or decline invitations, for one event or the whole series

description.p: The app has no servers and no telemetry. Sign-in tokens are kept in the system keychain.
